summary: The victim's MetaMask account was drained across multiple blockchains after an attacker obtained the wallet private key and remotely transferred all assets. A compromised browser extension was identified as a possible credential theft vector but the exact compromise mechanism was not confirmed.
user_mistake: Installed a browser extension with broad permissions that was later suspected of compromise
prevention: Remove unnecessary browser extensions from wallets used for cryptocurrency / Install extensions only from trusted publishers after reviewing requested permissions
